notes:
Lead: Seedling Querybench — seed-stage legaltech building a contract Q&A assistant for SMB law firms. Inbound from doc-search blog + hosted API signup (self-serve). Founder (A. Singh, CTO) says: "We need a fast, cheap way to index ~100k contract pages and answer client questions in-app". Key details/tradeoffs captured: 
- Data: ~100k documents (mostly contracts + redlines), ~150MB text after cleaning. Freshness: daily delta updates (new signed agreements).
- Current stack: prototype using Chroma + local Llama2 embeddings; moving to hosted embeddings for reliability. Using Airtable + Notion for metadata; want vector DB for search layer (evaluating Pinecone/Chroma/Weaviate).
- Primary workload: retrieval-augmented generation for contract Q&A (chat + single-question); batch reranking on top-K results (they care about precision across top 3).
- Latency targets: p50 < 150ms for pure embedding lookups, p95 < 400ms end-to-end for short Q&A. Throughput: expect bursty traffic, avg 5-15 QPS, peak ~40 QPS. Cost sensitivity: high (startup budget).
- Model preferences: open models for now (Llama2/Redwood-compat), but want simple path to switch to higher-quality variants if needed.
- Routing/fallback: plan for hosted API primary; want canary fallbacks to cheaper model for non-critical queries.
- Security/compliance: require SSO/SAML for team, audit logs for admin actions, and exportable embedding data for legal hold. Retention policy question — want 30-90d configurable.
- POC asks from eng: (1) canonical sample code to push embeddings to Pinecone + hosted embed API; (2) example reranker pipeline (score + rescore) using Redwood responses; (3) cost estimator for 10k queries/day with 8-12 top-k reranks.
- Quote from CTO on call: "We like how fast signup was — want to validate accuracy vs our Chroma baseline before moving billing."
- Comments: candidate for self-serve Hosted API POC. Recommend low-friction onboarding doc (sample dataset, small notebook) + 2-week credit to run embedding+rerank experiment. Provide explicit notes on export/retention and a sample canary routing policy.
- Risk: if embedding vector DB cost can't be kept low they may stay with self-hosted Chroma; must show savings or better SLA to convert.
short_description: SMB legaltech inbound — evaluating Redwood Hosted API for embeddings + reranking; early discovery, high cost sensitivity, public cloud, wants Pinecone/Chroma integration patterns.
